why: Q5: one global reduced-motion clamp must not break Base UI exit animations. Q8: 3,694 axe `incomplete` colour-contrast nodes have unknown real ratios (docs/v3/concepts/quality-contract.md section 10; docs/v3/evidence/gap-a11y-i18n-print-contract.md).
what: tools/spikes/motion-contrast/**, docs/v3/spikes/motion-contrast.md and the Q8 record docs/v3/evidence/q8-contrast-incomplete.md. Uses prim-p4's overlays and qa-i4's matrix (axe-core, @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0 in the spike's package.json). The clamp is a harness constant of at most 6 CSS lines (`animation-duration`, `transition-duration` 0.01ms) under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
must_not_touch: consumer repos (scratch copies live in the OS temp dir)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/quality-contract.md section 10 Q5 and Q8 are frozen.
change: Q5: under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'` with the clamp, open and close dialog, sheet, popover, toast; an exit finishes when `document.getAnimations()` is empty and the element unmounts within 1 s. Q8: for each colour-contrast `incomplete` node of the matrix run (state it if below 3,694), screenshot its rect with its own text made transparent; background = the pixel whose luminance is farthest from the text colour; ratio = contrastRatio(text colour, that pixel). `pass` >= 4.5 (>= 3.0 for large text: 24 css px, or 18.66 bold); `fail` below; `unresolved` when off-screen, zero-sized, over video or canvas, or gradient text. `incompleteCeiling` = the node count x 1.05, rounded up.
commits: One non-package commit `chore: spike motion-contrast harness and verdict`, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: run.ts JSON plus the verdict doc; run twice, attach both outputs.
acceptance: docs/v3/evidence/q8-contrast-incomplete.md holds the Q8 counts and ceiling

verdict: `Q5: PASS|REFUTED` (REFUTED when any exit never finishes: per-part `motion-reduce:` classes) and `Q8: PASS|REFUTED` (PASS = `q8.fail` is 0, so the ceiling on the count stands and coverage stays 'not covered'; REFUTED lists failing nodes for the owning Issues). `Verdict: PASS` iff both PASS; run.ts `verdict` the same.
